parsed.post: Significant improvement found by increasing DEPTH to 8 (val_bpb 1.107 -> 1.035). Increasing model capacity seems highly effective within the 5-minute budget. Now exploring whether increasing the learning rate alongside depth helps exploit the additional parameters.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.12 to see if higher capacity (Depth 8) can handle a more aggressive learning rate.
